step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram illustrates UltraServe's SmartStack platform and the USC (UltraServe Commerce) application environment it deploys. On the left side (SmartStack control plane), developers/users interact with an ALB or upload build artifacts to an S3 bucket. The ALB routes traffic to stateless Lambda microservices, which manage application state via DynamoDB and trigger deployment workflows in CodeBuild using dynamically generated Terraform templates. CodeBuild provisions and orchestrates the USC environment on the right side, which consists of S3, Aurora database, ECR registry, ECS containers, and an ELB for handling commerce traffic. Additionally, Lambda monitors S3 for code updates, building container images stored in ECR and deploying them to ECS.

edges.notes: User accesses SmartStack API or UI via ALB
ALB forwards API requests to Lambda microservices

Lambda generates dynamic Terraform configurations and triggers CodeBuild execution

User uploads custom code or application updates into S3 bucket
Lambda polls S3 bucket for new application code versions
Lambda triggers build of container images into ECR
